prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Are you comfortable continuing on the recording?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the impact?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I had slowed a little because traffic was backed up on the cross street. Then a vehicle came from my right side and didn't stop for its red light.

Q: Did you have any time to react before the impact?

A: Not really. I hit the brakes, but it all happened very fast. The other car hit the driver's side door of mine.

Q: Where were you holding the steering wheel when it hit?

A: With both hands, I think. My left hand was on the wheel and my right was reaching for the gear shift. My wrist kind of snapped when the airbag went off.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor afterward?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They took X-rays and said my wrist was fractured. I've been fitted for a cast and I have a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic doctor next week.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Has anyone else been in contact with you about the accident since then?

A: Only the other driver's insurance company. They called me once, and I told them I'd wait to talk until I spoke with my own insurer.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: I just want to make sure it's clear that the light was green for me and that I was driving carefully.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
